svg.title: Blue Floor Panel for Leo
svg.desc: Interpretive vector study after the viewed reference. Approximate geometry; framing, wall, shadows and paint texture omitted. Museum-supplied 2026 installation photograph and caption explicitly identify Blue Floor Panel for Leo (1992). Observed floor projection only; four edges visible. No claim that projected outline is an orthographic plan. Known floor-plan dimensions do not establish projected wall-style geometry.
